svg.text: Micromouse 4WD 2.11:1 Drivetrain — Parallel Axle Mounting Layout
Module 0.5 / 20° involute / POM · 19T → 40T (3 gears/side) · registered to xiao 2-layer PCB · 2026-08-10
A — SIDE ELEVATION (one side plate pair, viewed from outboard)
All 3 axes are collinear on the wheel-axle line. Scale 1:1 at 6 px/mm. Dimensions in mm.
B — LATERAL SECTION THROUGH ONE WHEEL AXLE (robot centreline at Y = 0, left side shown)
Both wheel axles use this identical stack. Y datum = robot centreline.
• Motor faceplate Y = 37.00 is PCB-DERIVED (board x = 13 / 87 on micromouse-pcb-simplified.kicad_pcb). Do not move it.
• All three gears share ONE plane, Y 37.50..41.50 - the N20's 10 mm shaft is long enough that the pinion needs no
• F683ZZ #1 pressed into the inner plate, flange counterbored on the INBOARD face, inner race flush at Y = 37.00
• F683ZZ #2 pressed into the outer plate, flange counterbored 1.0 deep from the OUTBOARD face so the rotating hub clears
• 0.5 shim between the inner-plate race and the axle gear; 0.8 shim between the outer-plate race and the wheel hub
• Deck ledge tapped M3 at X = +/-9.00, Y = 32.75 - lands under the PCB's H1..H4. PCB underside sits at Z = 5.00.
• Wheel is the mini-sumo wheel measured from miniSumoWheel.3mf: ∅27.0 rolling (silicone in a ∅23.31
channel), 19.06 wide, 6 x ∅3.59 on a ∅16.05 bolt circle, ∅2.85 bore.
• Motor cradle is SPLIT on the axle plane and bolted: both halves print trough-up with no supports, and the motors drop
in rather than being threaded through a sealed bore.
• Overall track over the wheel hubs = 122.12
